title: What Manual Therapy Really Does — And How to Explain It to Patients

hook.en: Bones are not "put back in place". Learn the model of how hands-on treatment helps, and the words that calm patients instead of scaring them.
hook.ur: Haddiyan "wapas jagah par nahi rakhi jatin". Haath ke ilaaj ke kaam karne ka model aur woh alfaz seekhein jo patients ko darane ki bajaye sukoon dein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll describe how manual therapy works using the neurophysiological and context model, avoid fear-making words, and give a clear, honest explanation.
goal.ur: End tak aap neurophysiological aur context model se bata sakenge ke manual therapy kaise kaam karti hai, dar paida karne wale alfaz se bachenge, aur saaf, imandaar wazahat denge.

text.en: When a joint is mobilised or manipulated, something real happens, but it is rarely a bone being repositioned. The best-supported model says that the force from your hands creates a **mechanical stimulus**, which triggers a **neurophysiological response** in the nerves, spinal cord and brain, and that response, together with **context effects** such as expectation and trust, changes **pain and movement**.
text.ur: Jab joint ko mobilise ya manipulate kiya jata hai to kuch asli hota hai, lekin aksar yeh haddi ka apni jagah par aana nahi hota. Sab se mazboot saboot wala model kehta hai ke aap ke haathon ki force ek **mechanical stimulus** banati hai, jo nerves, spinal cord aur dimagh mein ek **neurophysiological response** shuru karti hai, aur yeh response, **context effects** (umeed aur bharosa) ke saath, **dard aur harkat** badalta hai.

text.en: Think of a dimmer switch for pain, not a wrench for a bolt. Your hands, your words and the patient's belief all turn the dimmer a little. The pain turns down, and for a short while movement feels easier. That window is when you add exercise, so the change lasts.
text.ur: Dard ke liye dimmer switch sochein, bolt ke liye pana nahi. Aap ke haath, aap ke alfaz aur patient ka yaqeen sab dimmer ko thora ghumate hain. Dard kam hota hai aur thori der harkat aasan lagti hai. Yehi woh mauqa hai jab exercise jorein taake badlao qayam rahe.

title.ur: Yeh asar kaise paida hota hai

steps.title: A mechanical stimulus
steps.detail: Your hands apply a force, movement or pressure to the tissues around a joint. || Mechanical stimulus

steps.title: A neurophysiological response
steps.detail: Nerves in the skin, muscle and joint send signals to the spinal cord and brain, which can reduce pain signals and muscle guarding. || Neurophysiological response

steps.title: Context effects
steps.detail: Expectation, the therapeutic relationship, the setting and the words you use all change how the patient experiences the treatment. || Context effects

steps.title: A clinical change
steps.detail: Pain eases and movement improves for a short time, which is the best moment to teach an exercise or an easy movement. || Clinical badlao

question.en: A patient asks, "Did you put my bone back in place?" What is the most honest reply?
question.ur: Patient poochta hai, "Kya aap ne meri haddi wapas jagah par rakhi?" Sab se imandaar jawab kya hai?

text.ur: "Koi farq nahi parta, bas letay rahein."

text.en: "Your joint was stiff and sore; the treatment calms the pain and lets it move more easily, and exercise helps keep that."
text.ur: "Aap ka joint akarha hua aur dardnak tha; ilaaj dard ko sukoon deta hai aur use aasani se hilne deta hai, aur exercise ise barqarar rakhti hai."

feedback.en: Yes — it is accurate, calm and points to exercise.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh durust, pur sukoon hai aur exercise ki taraf le jata hai.

text.en: "Yes, your bone was out of place."
text.ur: "Haan, aap ki haddi jagah se hati hui thi."

feedback.en: There is little evidence for this and it can frighten the patient.
feedback.ur: Iska saboot kam hai aur patient ko dara sakta hai.

title.en: Words that scare and words that help
title.ur: Dara dene wale aur madadgar alfaz

rows.ur: "Aap ka pelvis jagah se hata hua hai"

rows.en: "Your pelvis is working a bit stiffly and we will help it move"
rows.ur: "Aap ka pelvis thora akarha chal raha hai aur hum use harkat dene mein madad karenge"

rows.en: Avoids a fragile, broken image of the body
rows.ur: Jism ki nazuk, toota hua tasveer se bachata hai
"Aap ki kamar kharab ho rahi hai"

rows.en: "Age-related changes in the back are common and usually not harmful"
rows.ur: "Umar ke saath kamar mein tabdeeliyan aam hain aur aksar nuksan-deh nahi"

rows.en: Scans show changes in many people without pain
rows.ur: Scans bohat se bagair dard walon mein bhi tabdeeli dikhate hain

rows.en: "You must come three times a week"
rows.ur: "Aap ko hafte mein teen baar aana hi hoga"

rows.en: "Treatment helps, but the exercises you do at home matter most"
rows.ur: "Ilaaj madad karta hai, lekin ghar ki exercises sab se ahem hain"

text.en: **Calm, accurate, active.** Say what you found in calm words, keep it true to the evidence, and always link the treatment to something the patient can do.
text.ur: **Pur sukoon, durust, active.** Jo paya woh pur sukoon alfaz mein batayein, saboot ke mutabiq rakhein, aur ilaaj ko hamesha aisi cheez se jorein jo patient khud kar sake.

text.en: **Promising a fix you cannot deliver.** Saying "I will realign your spine" or "this will cure it" creates false expectations, and when the pain returns the patient loses trust. Describe a likely short-term change and the role of exercise.
text.ur: **Aisi marammat ka wada jo aap nahi de sakte.** "Main aap ki reerh ki haddi seedhi kar dunga" ya "yeh theek kar dega" jhooti umeed paida karta hai, aur dard wapas aaye to patient ka bharosa toot jata hai. Mumkin short-term badlao aur exercise ka kirdar bayan karein.

question.en: What does the neurophysiological model say manual therapy mainly changes?
question.ur: Neurophysiological model ke mutabiq manual therapy zyada tar kya badalti hai?

text.en: The length of the ligaments permanently
text.ur: Ligaments ki lambai hamesha ke liye

feedback.en: Ligament length does not change permanently with these techniques.
feedback.ur: In techniques se ligament ki lambai hamesha ke liye nahi badalti.

text.en: How the nervous system processes pain and movement
text.ur: Nervous system dard aur harkat ko kaise process karta hai

feedback.en: Yes — the effect is mainly through the nervous system and context, not by repositioning a bone.
feedback.ur: Haan — asar zyada tar nervous system aur context se hota hai, haddi ki jagah badalne se nahi.

feedback.en: Imaging studies do not show a bone moving back into place.
feedback.ur: Imaging studies mein haddi wapas jagah par aati nazar nahi aati.

question.en: Why add an exercise right after a manual technique?
question.ur: Manual technique ke foran baad exercise kyun jorein?

text.en: Because the patient can pay less
text.ur: Kyunke patient kam paise de sakta hai

text.en: Because exercise removes the effect of the technique
text.ur: Kyunke exercise technique ka asar khatam kar deti hai

feedback.en: Exercise helps to hold the gain.

text.en: Because pain is lower and movement is easier for a short while, so the change can be used and held
text.ur: Kyunke thori der dard kam aur harkat aasan hoti hai, is liye badlao istemal aur barqarar kiya ja sakta hai

feedback.en: Yes — the window is short, so use it.
feedback.ur: Haan — mauqa chhota hai, is liye istemal karein.

text.en: **Use the same explanation every time.** "I will use my hands to ease the pain and help you move, then show you what to do at home." Combine it with education about the usual, good course of pain, and set a clear goal for the next visit.
text.ur: **Har baar wohi wazahat dein.** "Main haathon se dard kam karunga aur aap ko harkat mein madad dunga, phir ghar ke liye batata hoon kya karna hai." Dard ke aam acche course ki education saath dein, aur agli visit ke liye wazeh maqsad rakhein.

question.en: Why can a patient feel better after a technique even if nothing in the joint has visibly changed?
question.ur: Technique ke baad patient behtar kyun mehsoos kar sakta hai jab joint mein kuch dikhai dene wala nahi badla?

answer.en: Because the experience of pain depends on the nervous system and the brain's judgement of threat, not only on the tissue. Touch, movement, expectation and trust can all lower that sense of threat and ease pain without a visible change in the joint.
answer.ur: Kyunke dard ka tajurba nervous system aur dimagh ke khatre ke andaze par munhasir hai, sirf tissue par nahi. Chhoona, harkat, umeed aur bharosa khatre ke ehsas ko kam kar ke dard ko bina kisi nazar aane wale joint badlao ke kam kar sakte hain.

beats.patient: A 47-year-old with three weeks of neck pain asks if the clicking sound means something was "put back".
beats.assessment: She is anxious and holds her neck stiffly; there are no red flags.
beats.treatment: Explain that a click is common and harmless, that the treatment calms pain and helps movement, and teach two neck exercises.
beats.reassess: She relaxes, moves further and returns with fewer worries about her neck.

text.en: **Honest explanation is not a licence to ignore red flags.** If pain is severe, unrelenting, linked with weight loss, fever, night pain, new weakness or loss of bladder or bowel control, stop the explanation and screen and refer. Reassurance only works after you have checked.
text.ur: **Imandaar wazahat red flags ko nazar andaz karne ka license nahi.** Agar dard shadeed, musalsal, wazan ghatne, bukhar, raat ke dard, nayi kamzori ya peshab pakhane par control ki kami ke saath ho to wazahat rok kar screen aur refer karein. Tasalli tab kaam karti hai jab aap jaanch kar chuke hon.

summary.en: Manual therapy works mainly through the nervous system and context effects (expectation, trust), not by putting bones back in place.
summary.ur: Manual therapy zyada tar nervous system aur context effects (umeed, bharosa) se kaam karti hai, haddiyon ko jagah par rakhne se nahi.

summary.en: The effect is a short window of less pain and easier movement: use it to teach an exercise so the change lasts.
summary.ur: Asar kam dard aur aasan harkat ka chhota mauqa hai: use exercise sikhane ke liye istemal karein taake badlao qayam rahe.

summary.en: Use calm, accurate words, avoid fear-making images and promises of a fix, and always link the treatment to what the patient can do.
summary.ur: Pur sukoon, durust alfaz istemal karein, dar paida karne wali tasveeron aur marammat ke waadon se bachein, aur ilaaj ko hamesha us cheez se jorein jo patient kar sakta hai.

front.en: What is the main route by which manual therapy relieves pain?
front.ur: Manual therapy dard kam karne ka zyada tar kaunsa raasta istemal karti hai?

back.en: Through the nervous system and context effects, not by repositioning bones.
back.ur: Nervous system aur context effects ke zariye, haddiyan jagah par rakh kar nahi.

back.en: The effects of expectation, trust, the setting and the words used on how treatment is experienced.
back.ur: Umeed, bharosa, mahaul aur alfaz ka ilaaj ke tajurbe par asar.

front.en: Why add an exercise straight after a technique?
front.ur: Technique ke foran baad exercise kyun?

back.en: Pain is lower and movement easier for a short time, so the gain can be held.
back.ur: Thori der dard kam aur harkat aasan hoti hai, is liye faida barqarar rakha ja sakta hai.

front.en: Give one phrase to avoid and one to use.
front.ur: Ek phrase jis se bachein aur ek jo istemal karein?

back.en: Avoid "your pelvis is out of place"; use "it is working stiffly and we will help it move".
back.ur: "Aap ka pelvis jagah se hata hua hai" se bachein; "yeh akarha chal raha hai aur hum madad karenge" istemal karein.

note.en: Why pain depends on the nervous system and threat.
note.ur: Dard nervous system aur khatre par kyun munhasir hai.

note.en: How to dose a mobilisation gently and safely.
note.ur: Mobilisation ko halka aur mehfooz dose kaise dein.
